requirements.text: The project must include main.cpp and CMakeLists.txt, which builds the executable count_even (or count_even.exe) without errors using CMake and C++17.
requirements.source_quote:
| Criterion | Points | What is checked |
|---|---:|---|
| Build | 1 | CMake creates `count_even` without errors |

requirements.text: CLI validation must reject argument counts other than two with exit code 1 and a message in stderr, and reject invalid numbers, values outside [-1000, 1000], or left > right with exit code 2 and a message in stderr.
requirements.source_quote:
| Criterion | Points | What is checked |
|---|---:|---|
| Build | 1 | CMake creates `count_even` without errors |
| Correctness | 2 | Correct results, inclusive bounds, zero and negative values |
| CLI validation | 1 | Correct exit codes and messages for invalid arguments |

requirements.text: The program must correctly count even integers in the inclusive interval [left, right], properly accounting for zero, negative values, and inclusive bounds.
requirements.source_quote:
| Criterion | Points | What is checked |
|---|---:|---|
| Build | 1 | CMake creates `count_even` without errors |
| Correctness | 2 | Correct results, inclusive bounds, zero and negative values |

requirements.text: On success, print only one integer count followed by newline to stdout (no other text). On error, stdout must be empty and error messages must go to stderr.
requirements.source_quote:
| Criterion | Points | What is checked |
|---|---:|---|
| Build | 1 | CMake creates `count_even` without errors |
| Correctness | 2 | Correct results, inclusive bounds, zero and negative values |
| CLI validation | 1 | Correct exit codes and messages for invalid arguments |
| Output format | 1 | Only one integer and a newline in stdout on success; stderr on errors |

criteria.title: Build
criteria.verification_method: Run `cmake -S . -B build` and `cmake --build build` to verify clean compilation without errors producing the `count_even` executable.

criteria.title: Correctness
criteria.description: Correct results, inclusive bounds, zero and negative values.
criteria.verification_method: Execute CLI runs across positive, negative, zero, and boundary intervals (e.g. 1 5 -> 2; -3 3 -> 3; 0 0 -> 1) and verify the counted even values.

criteria.title: CLI validation
criteria.description: Correct exit codes and messages for invalid arguments.
criteria.verification_method: Execute tests with arity != 2 (expect exit code 1 and stderr message), and with non-integer inputs, out-of-range inputs (< -1000 or > 1000), or left > right (expect exit code 2 and stderr message).

criteria.title: Output format
criteria.description: Only one integer and a newline in stdout on success; stderr on errors.
criteria.verification_method: Inspect standard output on successful runs to ensure exactly one integer count and a newline with no other text, and verify stdout is completely empty on error conditions.
